summary: Commissioner of Agriculture Doyle Conner submitted a standardized review form indicating that his agency reviewed the draft Environmental Impact Statement on off-road vehicle use on public lands. The form shows no adverse comments or concerns were checked, and no enclosures were attached, indicating the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services had no objections to the proposal.
